intro: Another lean fortnight for new factual orders. Channel 4 doubled the run of its Florida relocation series and added a third festive railway special, while Sky named the commissioners behind two new documentaries. ITVS has set the date for its next Independent Lens production call.

commissions.title: Escape to Florida (series 2)
commissions.what: Recommission of the lifestyle series following Britons who move to Florida for a new life, rising from 20 to 30 episodes. Supported by Northern Ireland Screen.
commissions.commissioner: Jo Street (Director of Nations and Regions and Head of Lifestyle) and Jayne Stanger (Senior Commissioning Editor)

commissions.title: Austrian Train At Christmas
commissions.what: New 60-minute festive special riding the Südbahn line from Graz to Vienna over the Semmering Pass, narrated by Hugh Bonneville. The third in the run after Nordic and Alpine Train At Christmas; filming is under way.
commissions.commissioner: Jayne Stanger (Senior Commissioning Editor, Lifestyle) and Jo Street (Director of Commissioning, Nations & Regions and Head of Lifestyle)
commissions.producer: King of Sunshine Productions with WPP Media Motion Entertainment

commissions.title: I Exposed Newcastle's Hidden Camera Creators
commissions.what: Digital documentary in the In Too Deep strand in which Tommy Murphy looks into creators who secretly film people on Newcastle's streets for social media. Backed by North East Screen; out now on Channel 4's YouTube channel.
commissions.commissioner: Ellie Winstanley (Commissioning Editor, News and Current Affairs)

commissions.title: Don't Forget Me: The Disappearance of Amy Fitzpatrick
commissions.what: Three-part series (3x60) on the 2008 disappearance of 15-year-old Amy Fitzpatrick in Spain, with access to both sides of her divided family and the Irish police. On Sky and NOW from 29 November.
commissions.commissioner: Phil Edgar-Jones (Executive Director, Unscripted Originals), Hayley Reynolds (Head of Documentary Commissioning) and Kathryn Taylor (Commissioning Editor)

commissions.title: Dangerous Debussy
commissions.what: One-hour film on Claude Debussy's private life and the women around him, narrated by Bessie Carter with performances of his music. Premieres 1 December on Sky Arts and NOW.
commissions.commissioner: Phil Edgar-Jones (Executive Director, Unscripted) and Benedetta Pinelli (Commissioning Editor)

funding.title: Independent Lens Production Call
funding.what: Co-production funding for standalone feature documentaries (60 to 90 minutes) on US stories, in mid to late production and aiming to finish post by summer 2028. Opens 4 January 2027 at 9am PST.

moves.name: Allison Graff-Weisner
moves.change: Appointed Chief Development Officer at Sundance Institute.
